description:
'''Laptop twee''' is a style of [[twee pop]] that blends [[indie pop]] and [[indietronica]] with influences drawing from [[electronic music]] and primarily [[Digital audio workstation|DAW]]-based [[internet music|internet]]-native production. The genre emerged in the early 2020s, originally coined by the Canadian blogger and musician [[friends&]].   

Notable acts include 300skullsandcounting, [[Bassvictim]], Worldpeace DMT, [[Ear (band)|ear]], [[Cootie Catcher (band)|Cootie Catcher]], MASSI, ASC, Cicada, [[Feeble Little Horse]], the sound chalk makes, Luko M, [[the Femcels]], b7anket, Josephine's Next Million Miles, and Amigos Imaginarios.
